# r/nbadiscussion (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** The 2026–27 Gravity Report Predictions: Twenty calls for the season, each with a probability, every one of them scored

**Body:**

Twenty calls for the 2026–27 season, each with a probability, every one of them scored in the Forecast Ledger.

Oklahoma City to win the title at 34%. TORQUE, our new team model, has them 5.8 points clear of everyone else.

Surprise team Toronto (47+ wins, 56%). Disappointment team Atlanta (40 or fewer, 48%). And San Antonio under 59.5.

Our calls, registered before tip-off and graded in public:
34%  OKC wins the title
6%  Finals: OKC vs Detroit
25%  Jokić wins MVP
70%  Wembanyama wins DPOY
…and 16 more, all on the public ledger.

Full article (free, no ads): https://thegravityreport.com/articles/predictions/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
